description: Significantly high transaction amount in a merchant category that is atypical for the customer's spending history or occupational/demographic profile. Often associated with account draining or unauthorized high-value purchases.
mitigation_steps: Block transaction and contact customer immediately.
Alert fraud investigation team for manual review.

description: The transaction originates from a geographical location (country, city, IP) that does not match known travel patterns of the customer or their usual location. Common in card-not-present fraud or account takeover.
The successful transaction is preceded by an excessive number of failed login attempts, suggesting a brute force attack or stolen credentials used to access the account.

A high-value transaction is completed in an extremely short duration following login, especially if login was anomalous (e.g. from new IP or device). May indicate bot automation or scripted unauthorized access.
The transaction is executed using a device (e.g. new mobile device) or channel (e.g. anomalous call center channel) not previously associated with this account or customer behavioral pattern.
mitigation_steps: Send verification alert to primary device.

description: A transaction (especially transfer or withdrawal) consumes a very high proportion of the current account balance, indicating a potential attempt to rapidly drain funds.
mitigation_steps: Place transaction on hold for manual review.

description: An international transaction is detected without prior customer travel notification to the bank. Common indicator of card cloning or stolen card fraud.
mitigation_steps: Block transaction if no travel notice exists.

description: An abrupt deviation from the customer's habitual spending pattern (e.g. a customer making small retail purchases suddenly buying high-value luxury goods).
mitigation_steps: Review transaction history to identify anomaly.

description: The transaction occurs at hours atypical for customer activity (e.g. late night / early morning for non-nightshift workers) or for the merchant.
mitigation_steps: Flag for subsequent review if combined with other indicators.
Adjust alert thresholds for this pattern.
